text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager triggered: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (eu-west) — SLO burn 28% over 10m. Alert group: latency-high. PD: page sent to primary on-call.

morgan: acked — looking now. any recent deploys?

pd-bot: morgan acknowledged the page.

sanjay: saw a small spike on qps 00:40 UTC, KV cache evictions jumped. dashboards -> https://grafana.company/eu-west/latency

julia: confirmed - p50 steady, p95 ~ 350ms -> 750ms p99. request size median unchanged. likely tail hotkeys + cache miss.

ops-lead: @morgan @sanjay if this is KV thrash can we route a subset to dedicated pool? how's capacity?

morgan: checking autoscaler and node pools. running: `rbctl get pools --region eu-west` -> 6/6 at target, cpu/gpu headroom ~ 6%

sanjay: autoscaler not spinning up because of cool-down. proposing temporary routing rule: move 10% traffic to dedicated-reserve-eu

julia: +1 for routing; also start warming prefix cache for heavy customers (run warm job for top keys)

morgan: applying traffic reroute now (dry run) -> `routectl shift --from=hosted-eu --to=dedicated-reserve-eu --pct=10 --reason='p99 spike, kv-evict'`

incident-bot: `routectl` executed by morgan: shift started -> 10% moved. Monitoring metrics for 2m.

sanjay: started a targeted warmup job for top 50 keys: `python tools/warm_cache.py --region eu-west --keys-file /tmp/top_keys.txt`

julia: warmup in progress, logs show success for 32/50 keys so far.

morgan: p99 dropped from 750ms -> 420ms after reroute & warmup. SLO burn down to 8% over 10m.

ops-lead: good. keep at 10% until stable for 15m, then scale back. note for postmortem: tweak autoscaler cooldown and consider auxiliary reserve.

pd-bot: Pager resolved by morgan. Incident status: mitigated, monitoring.

morgan: will follow up with a short incident note and assign action items: 1) autoscaler cooldown tweak 2) KV eviction alert threshold 3) runbook update for routing to dedicated pool.

julia: filing follow-up tickets. thanks team :tada:

sanjay: marking this thread done from ops side. will watch for regressions.

morgan: handoff to night on-call in 30m — leaving notes in rotation doc. closing thread in 10m if stable.
